name: animations.scss
html:
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  animations.scss — view-animations scoped styles: the animations-reference
//  listing (alt/longdesc records per animated element) inside the internals
//  chrome + legal footer (adopted into the shadow root).
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

@import '../../../core/sass/base/variables';
@import '../../../core/sass/base/mixins';
@import '../../../core/sass/base/fonts';
@import '../../../core/sass/base/placeholders';
@import '../../../core/sass/base/structure';
@import '../../../core/sass/components/home/awards-footer';

// ── Animations Reference Isolated Styles ─────────────────────────────────────
$_B_ANIM: 'animations';
$_B_INTERNAL: 'internal';

// Internals chrome — same title/description treatment as view-legal.
.#{$_B_INTERNAL}-title {
  @extend %MAXAREA;
  @extend .ttl-lg;
  @extend .ttl-special;

  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  margin: 0 auto;
  text-align: center;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  padding: to-rem($space-4xl) to-rem($space-xl) to-rem($space-2xl);
  color: var(--text-primary);

  @include layout-768() {
    padding: to-rem($space-4xl) to-rem($space-2xl) to-rem($space-3xl);
  }

  @include layout-1024() {
    padding: to-rem($space-4xl) to-rem($space-3xl) to-rem($space-3xl);
  }

  @include layout-1920() {
    padding: to-rem($space-5xl) to-rem($space-4xl);
  }

  span {
    display: inline-block;
    text-align: center;
    margin: 0 auto;
  }
}

.#{$_B_INTERNAL}-description {
  @extend %MAXAREA;

  margin: 0 auto;
  padding-top: to-rem($space-2xl);
  padding-bottom: to-rem($space-xl);
}

.#{$_B_INTERNAL}-description-text {
  @extend %MAXAREA;
  @extend .txt-md;

  display: block;
  font-family: var(--font-primary);
  font-weight: 100;
  word-break: normal;
  overflow-wrap: break-word;
  hyphens: none;
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding-bottom: to-rem($space-lg);
  color: var(--text-secondary);

  @include layout-1024() {
    padding-left: 25%;
    padding-right: 25%;
    padding-bottom: to-rem($space-xl);
  }
}

:host {
  display: block;
  background-color: var(--bg-primary);
  color: var(--text-primary);
  min-height: 100vh;
  min-height: 100dvh;
}

article {
  display: block;
  background-color: var(--bg-primary);
  color: var(--text-primary);
  min-height: 100vh;
  min-height: 100dvh;
}

.#{$_B_ANIM} {
  background-color: var(--bg-primary);
  color: var(--text-primary);
  min-height: 100vh;
  min-height: 100dvh;
}

// The record list column — same readable-measure rhythm as the legal
// document: full gutter on phone, 25% side insets on desktop.
.#{$_B_ANIM}-list {
  @extend %MAXAREA;

  margin: 0 auto;
  padding-top: to-rem($space-2xl);
  padding-bottom: to-rem($space-xl);

  @include layout-1024() {
    padding-left: 25%;
    padding-right: 25%;
  }
}

.#{$_B_ANIM}-record {
  padding-bottom: to-rem($space-2xl);
}

.#{$_B_ANIM}-term {
  @extend .txt-md;

  font-family: var(--font-primary);
  font-weight: 300;
  color: var(--text-primary);
  padding-bottom: to-rem($space-sm);
}

.#{$_B_ANIM}-desc {
  @extend .txt-md;

  font-family: var(--font-primary);
  font-weight: 100;
  word-break: normal;
  overflow-wrap: break-word;
  hyphens: none;
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
}
